title: Understanding Singular Values
text: The singular values of a matrix are related to the variance of its features. The largest singular value is often associated with the feature having the highest variance.

title: Relation Between Variance and Singular Values
text: The singular values of a matrix are the square roots of the eigenvalues of the matrix's covariance matrix. The variance of a feature is directly related to these eigenvalues.

title: Finding the Largest Singular Value
text: To find the largest singular value, consider the feature with the highest variance. The largest singular value is the square root of this variance.

title: Calculate the Largest Singular Value
text: Given the variances $$125$$, $$20$$, and $$5$$, calculate the largest singular value by taking the square root of the largest variance.
